work.title: Extract EvidenceService
work.description: Move trace recording, trace ID assignment, todo/result matching, artifact validation, command output bounding and hashing, and evidence redaction into EvidenceService.
acceptance: Result todo IDs exactly match the started todo contract
Artifact paths are validated against candidate commits
Command evidence remains tied to the current attempt
Full command output remains disposable while its digest remains durable
EvidenceService has no authority to change lifecycle stage
